note: Antrim County zones 7 townships and 5 villages (Banks, Elk Rapids, Forest Home, Helena, Kearney, Milton, Torch Lake; Bellaire, Central Lake, Elk Rapids, Ellsworth, Mancelona). Their zoning is published only as PDF maps (county zoned-municipalities map, Elk Rapids Village and Township zoning maps). The county GIS ArcGIS viewer (antrimcounty.maps.arcgis.com) exposes no zoning layer in its public item or services; ArcGIS Online searches found no Antrim zoning feature service. Only commercial sources (Regrid, Zoneomics) carry zoning polygons.
